__
 
• Protozoa are single-celled creatures. example:Amoeba
 
• The organisms belonging to the phylum Nematoda are also known as “**roundworms**”.
 
• Arthropoda is the largest phylum with about nine lakh species.example:cockroach.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Protozoa**:

 
 
• Protozoa are single-celled creatures.
 
• They range in size and shape from amoeba, which can change shape, to paramecium
 
• Eukaryotic and single-celled creatures make up the majority of protozoans.
 
• Amoeba, Paramecium, Trypanosoma, Plasmodium, and other protozoa are examples.
 
 
 
• **Nematodes**
 
 
• present in the soil feed on the bacteria, fungi, and other nematodes, and play an important role in nutrient recycling.
 
• They also attack the insects and control the pests. However, they cause severe damage to plants.
 
• They feed on the plant roots and reduce the nutrient .
 
• They cause diseases such as Ascariasis, Trichuriasis, Hookworm, Enterobiasis, Filariasis, and Angiostrongyliasis in humans.
 
 
 
• **Arthropoda**:
 
 
• The body is triploblastic, segmented, and bilaterally symmetrical.
 
• The body is divided into head, thorax, and abdomen.
 
• They have an open circulatory system,The head bears a pair of compound eyes.
 
• The exoskeleton is made of chitin.
 
• They are unisexual and fertilization is either external or internal.
 
• Example-Cockroaches,Spider,Centipede,American Lobster
 
 
 
• **Echinodermata**:
 
 
• They have a star-like appearance and are spherical or elongated.
 
• They are exclusively marine animals, organisms are spiny-skinned.
 
• The skeleton is made up of calcium carbonate.
 
• They have an open circulatory system.
 
• They respire through gills or cloacal respiratory tree.
 
• Examples- Starfish,Sea urchin,Common Brittle star
